# lkj

> A dump of homeless useful utils


## Pages in this subsection

- [lkj](lkj.html.md): Lightweight Kit Jumpstart
- [lkj.chunking](lkj.chunking.html.md): Tools for chunking (segumentation, batching, slicing, etc.)
- [lkj.dicts](lkj.dicts.html.md): Tools for working with dictionaries (and other Mappings).
- [lkj.filesys](lkj.filesys.html.md): File system utils
- [lkj.funcs](lkj.funcs.html.md): Tools for working with functions.
- [lkj.importing](lkj.importing.html.md): Tools for importing
- [lkj.iterables](lkj.iterables.html.md): Tools with iterables (dicts, lists, tuples, sets, etc.).
- [lkj.loggers](lkj.loggers.html.md): Utils for logging.
- [lkj.misc](lkj.misc.html.md): Miscellaneous tools.
- [lkj.strings](lkj.strings.html.md): String Utilities Module

## Optional
